_meta.principle: Transitions are between shots, not within. Used by the assembly stage (or storyboarded as a paired end-frame of shot N and start-frame of shot N+1). Most cuts should be hard cuts; reserve transitions for moments where the bridge IS the storytelling.
consumed_by: tools/pipelines/video/campaign.mjs Stage 5 assembly — transition handling between shots (future)
manual storyboard — pair end-frame of shot N + start-frame of shot N+1 to read as a bridge

match_bridges._label: Match bridges — visual rhyme between shots

match_cut_shape.name: Match Cut on Shape
match_cut_shape.use: Two shots share a shape that rhymes (circle in shot N → circle in shot N+1) — used for time/place jumps
match_cut_shape.fragment: end-frame of shot N centered on a circular shape; start-frame of shot N+1 opens on a different circular shape in the same screen position

match_cut_action.name: Match Cut on Action
match_cut_action.use: Same action continues across two shots — hand reaching across a cut
match_cut_action.fragment: end-frame of shot N captures hand mid-reach; start-frame of shot N+1 picks up the same hand finishing the reach in a new context

object_wipe.name: Object Wipe
object_wipe.use: An object moves across the frame and reveals shot N+1 behind it
object_wipe.fragment: an object passes laterally across the lens at the cut, revealing the new scene as it clears

whip_pan_transition.name: Whip Pan Transition
whip_pan_transition.use: High-energy social ads — fast pan ends shot N, fast pan opens shot N+1, motion blur between hides the cut
whip_pan_transition.fragment: shot N ends with a fast pan in one direction; shot N+1 begins mid-pan in the same direction; motion blur bridges the cut

smash_cut.name: Smash Cut
smash_cut.use: Hard tonal contrast — soft scene smashes into loud scene with no gentle bridge
smash_cut.fragment: instant hard cut from a calm static shot to a high-energy shot — no fade, no overlap

motion_blur_bridge.name: Motion Blur Bridge
motion_blur_bridge.use: Generic cover for any cut where the shots don't visually rhyme — applied in post
motion_blur_bridge.fragment: 8-frame motion blur applied to the last 4 frames of shot N and first 4 frames of shot N+1

occlusion_bridges._label: Occlusion bridges — something covers the lens at the cut

hand_occlusion.name: Hand Occlusion
hand_occlusion.use: Hand passes in front of camera at end of shot N; shot N+1 opens with the hand pulling back
hand_occlusion.fragment: shot N ends with a hand sweeping across the lens; shot N+1 opens with the same hand pulling back from the lens

before_after_split.name: Before/After Split
before_after_split.use: Direct compare — left half is before, right half is after, cut on the split bar slide
before_after_split.fragment: vertical split bar slides across the frame from left to right, revealing the after state behind it
